# Verdesk

> Local MCP server for Windows. Your AI agents use your PC and browse any page. Free for personal use; Pro adds action scripting, remote PCs and commercial use (full Pro free for the first 60 days).

Verdesk is a single-executable MCP server that runs on your own Windows 10/11 machine and works with any MCP client and any model (tested on Claude Code). It drives both the browser and desktop programs.

## Features

- All in one: browser and desktop in a single server.
- Cheaper than Computer Use: sends only what changed instead of a full screenshot every turn — 89% fewer vision tokens in a simulated 20-turn benchmark (6 of 96 screen cells changing per turn; 47% when half the screen changes).
- Browser in DOM mode: reads the page through its code, without images (full read measured at 24–34 ms). For sites that allow automation.
- Undetectable browsing mode: drives your everyday browser with a real mouse and keyboard, without an automation connection (navigator.webdriver = false). For demanding sites.
- Standard MCP: any model, any MCP client.
- Native OCR: reads the text on screen without sending images to the agent.
- Capture zones: looks only at the part of the screen that matters.
- Change detection: sends only what changed since the last look, and can wait for something to change.
- Action log: every agent action is recorded and visible.
- Optional sounds: a cue when an agent connects or acts; can be turned off in Settings.
- Action scripting (Pro): record a desktop task once and repeat it with a single call.
- Mini button captures (Pro): save a button once; the agent finds it on screen and presses it, even without text.
- Remote PCs (Pro): control other machines over an SSH tunnel with your own keys, no third-party broker.

## Examples

Paperwork on web portals; Windows programs without an API; extracting data from web pages; testing your own application; changing Windows settings; repeating desktop tasks.
